WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND ( UPPER(ASSIGNEE_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(ASSIGNEE_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
mapper.select:
SELECT ASSIGNEE_ID, ASSIGNEE_CODE, ASSIGNEE_NAME, ACTIVE_FLAG FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, ordered_assignee.* FROM ( SELECT ASSIGNEE_ID, ASSIGNEE_CODE, ASSIGNEE_NAME, ACTIVE_FLAG FROM ASSIGNEE
ORDER BY ASSIGNEE_CODE ASC ) ordered_assignee WHERE ROWNUM <= #{pageNum} * #{amount} ) WHERE rn > (#{pageNum} - 1) * #{amount} ORDER BY ASSIGNEE_CODE ASC
SELECT ASSIGNEE_ID, ASSIGNEE_CODE, ASSIGNEE_NAME, ACTIVE_FLAG FROM ASSIGNEE WHERE ASSIGNEE_ID = #{assigneeId}
